answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A spiral of per-task receipts records who did what, and the willow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the trellis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
